_note: B37 computer school: computing nouns in natural scenes – a ground-floor lab, an upstairs lab and a break corner; English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_seance_noun.hook: The tutor raises one finger: 'SAY it ONCE!' – SAY-ONCE, a lesson session (say-AHNS).
fr_seance_noun.why: la séance = session, sitting Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (say-AHNSS) -> (say-AHNS) to match the card.

fr_souris_noun.hook: The boy opens his palms – 'SORRY!' – as the mouse slips off the table and dangles by its cord (soo-REE).

fr_ressource_noun.hook: The girl goes back to the bookshelf, her SOURCE, again and again – RE-SOURCE (ruh-SOORS).
fr_ressource_noun.why: la ressource = resource Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (ruh-SOORSS) -> (ruh-SOORS) to match the card.

fr_programme_noun.hook: The boy holds up his whole PROGRAM, printed out so long it spills to the floor (proh-GRAHM).
fr_programme_noun.why: le programme = program, programme Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pro-GRAM -> proh-GRAHM).

fr_ordinateur_noun.hook: The old computer puts everything in ORDER – the ORDER-NATOR (or-dee-na-TUR).

fr_internet_noun.hook: The glowing globe is wrapped in a NET of lines joining every country – the INTERNET (an-tair-NET).

fr_systeme_noun.hook: The tall cabinet of blinking lights runs the whole SYSTEM (sees-TEHM).
fr_systeme_noun.why: le système = system Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (sees-TEM -> sees-TEHM).

fr_code_noun.hook: Tap the secret CODE into the keypad on the wall (kod).

fr_reseau_noun.hook: The technician kneels to RE-SEW the torn net of blue cables with a big needle – RE-SEW, the network (ray-ZOH).

fr_chercheur_noun.hook: The researcher holds out his notebook: 'SHARE? SURE!' – SHARE-SURE, the researcher (shehr-SHUHR).
fr_chercheur_noun.why: le chercheur = researcher Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (shair-SHUR -> shehr-SHUHR).

fr_telecommunication_noun.hook: The big white dish on the roof outside the window calls far away – TELECOMMUNICATION (tay-lay-koh-mew-nee-kah-SYOHN).
fr_telecommunication_noun.why: la télécommunication = telecommunication Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (tay-lay-ko-mu-nee-ka-SYON -> tay-lay-koh-mew-nee-kah-SYOHN).

fr_simulation_noun.hook: The boy flies through the clouds without leaving his seat – a flight SIMULATION (see-mew-lah-SYOHN).
fr_simulation_noun.why: la simulation = simulation Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (see-mu-la-SYON -> see-mew-lah-SYOHN).

fr_suppression_noun.hook: She SUPPRESSES the mess – crumpled paper straight into the bin: deleted (sew-pray-SYOHN).
fr_suppression_noun.why: la suppression = deletion, removal Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (su-pray-SYON -> sew-pray-SYOHN).

fr_connexion_noun.hook: The two girls push the two cable ends together – a CONNECTION (koh-nehk-SYOHN).
fr_connexion_noun.why: la connexion = connection; login Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ko-nek-SYON -> koh-nehk-SYOHN).

fr_protocole_noun.hook: The man in the grey suit ticks every step on his clipboard – he follows PROTOCOL (proh-toh-KOL).
fr_protocole_noun.why: le protocole = protocol Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pro-to-KOL -> proh-toh-KOL).

fr_moniteur_noun.hook: A huge MONITOR screen glows on the desk (moh-nee-TUHR).
fr_moniteur_noun.why: le moniteur = monitor Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (mo-nee-TUR -> moh-nee-TUHR).

fr_automate_noun.hook: The little brass robot walks all by itself – an AUTOMATON, an AUTO-MATE (oh-toh-MAHT).
fr_automate_noun.why: l'automate = automaton Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (o-to-MAT -> oh-toh-MAHT).

fr_clavier_noun.hook: He plays the computer keyboard with both hands like an old CLAVIER, a piano (klah-VYAY).
fr_clavier_noun.why: le clavier = keyboard Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kla-VYAY -> klah-VYAY).

fr_informatique_noun.hook: She opens the computer to INFORM her friend how it works inside – INFORM-ATICS, computer science (an-for-ma-TEEK).

fr_halte_noun.hook: She raises her palm: 'HALT! Time for a break' – and picks up her sandwich (alt).

fr_console_noun.hook: She CONSOLES her sad friend who lost the game on his console (kohn-SOL).
fr_console_noun.why: la console = (games) console Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kon-SOL -> kohn-SOL).

fr_mail_noun.hook: He sends a MAIL from his laptop – shown flying off as a paper airplane (mel).

fr_logiciel_noun.hook: He breaks the red wax SEAL on the new box of software – LOGIC-SEAL (loh-zhee-SYEHL).
fr_logiciel_noun.why: le logiciel = software, program Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (lo-zhee-SYEL -> loh-zhee-SYEHL).

fr_informaticien_noun.hook: The IT specialist works like an INFORMATION MAGICIAN – top hat, wand and toolbag (an-for-ma-tee-SYAN).

fr_donnee_noun.hook: A young scientist named Donny ("doh-NAY") stands on the floor and presses a single red dot, one DATUM, onto a giant empty graph on the wall.
fr_donnee_noun.why: Donny ~ donnee; moved to the computing floor Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (do-NAY -> doh-NAY).

fr_recepteur_noun.hook: In the armchair upstairs, a man presses the telephone RECEIVER to his ear in surprise, the rotary phone on the side table beside him (ray-sehp-TUHR).
fr_recepteur_noun.why: receptor ~ recepteur; moved from the hotel terrace to the telecom floor
